## Overview

This page compares event-study figures between two balancing approaches:

- Original (JJP Final): Balanced using `lexp_ma_strict`
- Alternative (JJP Alt): Balanced using `lexp`

The comparison includes Figure 1 (event-study results by baseline spending quartile) and Figure 2 (high vs low predicted spending and quartile breakdowns) across multiple specifications.
